reviews.review:
The multiplayer: Eh.

The singleplayer: FOR THA EMPRAH!

Ever wanted to be a bloody space marine? Here's the game.

Other than that, it's nothing hugely special; shooting orks and running around screaming "FOR TEH EMPARAR!!" was worth the price of entry for me. :D

Note: as of about a month ago, there were still some people doing some multiplayer, so at least it's not dead if that interests you.

Absolutely a positive surprise for me! I installed it with hopes of no more than a quick and fun game, but it really blew my socks off! Lots of gore, grimdark over-the-top manliness, thunder hammers, melta guns, orcs, chaos and - oh yeah - grimdark - and that's just the campaing. I'm currently enjoying the multiplayer part and so far the customization and xp-ladder seems great.

Story and Single player are the strong points of this game. Its what you expect to feel like if you where a SPACE MARINE! multiplayer, meh, co-op horde stuff is fun, but PvP is clunky and not really that fun. Single players and co-op, thats where its at guys

I'm someone that loves WH40k and this game is a good entry into the universe. BUTT. There are a lot of reasons why this game just isn't as good as it could/should be. Firstly, the story is short. Very shot. Like you can probably beat this game in one sitting short. But you could tell that they wanted to do more with the story in future additions. So while the story is short, and there isn't a lot or any replayability on that end, lets turn to the multiplayer.

The multiplayer is utterly abysmal. Let me elaborate. Character and class customization is cool and allows you to play as almost any of your favorite Chapter/Warband. Finding a game is almost impossible, most of the time there is only one game running and because it's all player hosted, get ready for lag. And lag plays a very key role in a firefight. For example, you can melee attack someone 5 times and do no damage despite it looking like you're doing damage, then all of a sudden you're dead because during that time the enemy appeared to be standing still, he was actually beating your skull in with a chainsword. Hacking is very rampant now compared to back when this game first came out. My guess is there is no anti-cheat, or if there is, it's very far out of date. So expect the random getting killed through walls, across the map one shot head shots, and the snap pistol shots from an assault marine in mid air right before he crushes you. 

All in all, there was an opportunity for greatness that feel short (RIP THQ). I only recommend buying this game if it's heavily discounted and even then, don't expect much. Stick to the story, and only venture into multiplayer if you're brave or ready for lots of frustration.

They don't make em like this anymore.
Best Warhammer 40k game ever, really put the universe to a whole new level.
It sucks that THQ closed down and now this game will never get the sequel it deserves...
or any other good Warhammer 40k game ever...
Overall this game was one of the best Hack and Slash I ever got to play.
